items.title: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increases
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey will reveal the new pay rates in the Budget, and has also announced measures to help households with the cost of living.

items.title: Two charged over alleged plot to assist Iran in RAF Fairford incident
items.summary: Mohmed Ahmad Abdulkarim and Nouman Essghir, both 24, will appear at Westminster Magistrates' Court on Tuesday.

items.title: Turnout so far highest in decades as Israelis vote in pivotal election
items.summary: The elections - the first since the Hamas-led attacks on Israel and the wars which followed - are widely seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu.

items.title: What does Israel's election mean for Gaza and the wider world?
items.summary: The BBC's diplomatic correspondent James Landale reports from Jerusalem as ballots are cast.

items.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
items.summary: The France star had referred to the former Chinese leader as a "dictator" during an interview about memes.

items.title: Kane ends England’s 25-year wait to win men’s Ballon d’Or award
items.summary: Harry Kane becomes the first English player to win the prize since Michael Owen in 2001, and Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas wins the Ballon d’Or Feminin for a record-equalling third time.

items.title: I'm a single mum and limit my weekly shop to £40 - here's what I want from the Budget
items.summary: People earning from £380 a month to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they want to see in this year's Budget.

items.title: Rise in sales of radios and tinned foods, say retailers, after call to stock up
items.summary: Figures obtained by BBC Newsnight show large spikes in sales of torches, radios and power banks.
